# How a release ships

A tagged release and a hotfix take different paths to the same approval.

<!-- cf-figure: figures/release-flow.json -->

Every step after the tag runs in CI. The person who approves the release
is the maintainer on call.

declaration.caption: Both paths stop at a red check and end with the maintainer on call publishing.
declaration.description: Four columns: start, build, gate, publish. Path A runs from a release tag to build and tests, to required checks, to approve and publish, all travelled. Path B runs from a hotfix branch to a merge into the release branch, to the release branch's checks, then along a path not yet travelled to the same approve and publish step. A red check that stops the release sits in the gate column on both paths.
